situation-room.codes-not-allowed-org: Only this room’s owner, or a coordinator named for your organisation, can check codes.
situation-room.codes-privacy-org: A used code shows the day it was used, never who used it. A code that is not your organisation’s, or does not exist, shows as “Not one of yours” — Hawkeye does not say which.
situation-room.codes-write-not-allowed: Only this room’s owner, or a coordinator named for your party, can withdraw or restore codes.
situation-room.codes-write-not-allowed-o: Only this room’s owner, or a coordinator named for your organisation, can withdraw or restore codes.
situation-room.codes-write-rate-limited: Too many changes in the last hour. Try again in {v0} minutes.
situation-room.codes-restore-cap: These codes cannot be restored: that would take you past your code limit.
situation-room.codes-write-failed: Could not save that change. Check your connection and try again.
situation-room.codes-withdraw-confirm-on: Withdraw 1 code? A withdrawn code can no longer be used to sign up. Accounts already created with your codes are not affected.
situation-room.codes-withdraw-confirm-ma: Withdraw {v0} codes? A withdrawn code can no longer be used to sign up. Accounts already created with your codes are not affected.
situation-room.codes-withdrawn-one: 1 code withdrawn. It can no longer be used to sign up.
situation-room.codes-withdrawn-many: {v0} codes withdrawn. They can no longer be used to sign up.
situation-room.codes-withdraw-skipped: Not withdrawn: {v0} — used or withdrawn in the meantime. See the status below.
situation-room.codes-restore-none: Nothing was restored: those codes are no longer withdrawn by this room. Their status is shown below.
situation-room.codes-restored-one: 1 code restored. It can be used to sign up again.
situation-room.codes-restored-many: {v0} codes restored. They can be used to sign up again.
situation-room.codes-withdraw-hint: Tick unused codes to withdraw them. A withdrawn code can no longer be used to sign up; codes withdrawn here can be restored.
